title: De novo designed proteins modulate GPCR signalling in the dopamine D1 receptor
summary: Zhejiang University designed four de novo GPCR exoframe modulators (GEMs) that target the transmembrane domain of the dopamine D1 receptor. Functional assays showed they act as positive, negative or biased allosteric modulators, and one restored activity in loss-of-function receptor mutants. Design is computational; the exact assay numbers were not checked against the full paper, so use the paper for quantitative claims.
ai_technology: Computational de novo protein design (AI-based protein design pipeline)
